name: MSCQRProductionGreenStageBReadinessMatrix
protectedShaBinding: runtime exact full origin/main SHA; never a reusable literal

rows.requirement: Deployment checkout is exact protected origin/main, clean, and non-shallow.
rows.consumer: all Stage B producers and validators
rows.freshness: source binding; any SHA change invalidates evidence
rows.signatureBinding: downstream signed artifacts bind tooling SHA
rows.testCoverage: deployment identity and workspace tests
rows.ciCoverage: Stage B deployment closure pull-request job

rows.requirement: Node, npm, Terraform, AWS CLI, git, gh, imports, region, KMS contract, filesystem, disk, and backend output preconditions are checked before evidence generation.
rows.identity: local process; no AWS API call
rows.freshness: must pass before administrator evidence clock
rows.testCoverage: readiness command tests

rows.requirement: Image impact/reuse or one authorized publication is bound to the protected SHA.
rows.freshness: image evidence contract; separate from 3600-second live evidence
rows.hashBinding: publication canonical/archive hashes and image digests
rows.expectedResourceActions: immutable image publication only when required
rows.testCoverage: image impact, dispatch, publisher, and evidence tests
rows.ciCoverage: Stage B deployment closure pull-request job

rows.requirement: Initial capability and plan-bound permission producers require the exact administrator boundary.
rows.hashBinding: source, image, state, plan, audit, approval
rows.signatureBinding: existing Stage B asymmetric KMS signature
rows.expectedResourceActions: IAM simulation only; no deployment mutation
rows.testCoverage: lifecycle, phase split, identity capability tests
rows.ciCoverage: Stage B control-plane and deployment closure

rows.requirement: Terraform/release operations use a fresh MFA-backed release-deployer session.
rows.consumer: release preflight, refresh, plan, audit, closure, verify-only, apply
rows.freshness: session lifetime and evidence TTL are independent
rows.testCoverage: identity and release gate tests; live MFA is operator-only
rows.gap: Live session availability cannot be proven offline.
rows.remediation: Probe the exact caller immediately before each release boundary.

rows.requirement: Backend configuration is producer-owned, private, atomic, and never pre-created by the caller.
rows.testCoverage: backend and release gate tests
rows.ciCoverage: Stage B control-plane and closure checks

rows.requirement: Terraform lineage and serial are canonical, non-negative safe integers and remain bound through the chain.
rows.consumer: refresh, recovery, plan, approval, closure, verify-only, apply
rows.freshness: any serial change invalidates downstream evidence
rows.testCoverage: serial, refresh, tfvars, plan approval, recovery tests

rows.requirement: Exactly one refresh-only observation is captured and the original observation remains immutable.
rows.hashBinding: refresh report, plan, and recovery attestation
rows.signatureBinding: recovery attestation signs the current refresh binding
rows.expectedResourceActions: CLEAN_REFRESH or exact reviewed alias update only
rows.testCoverage: refresh-only and recovery classifier tests

rows.requirement: Present-time signed recovery attestation authorizes only classification/progression to a fresh plan.
rows.consumer: canonical recovery verifier and recovery classifier
rows.hashBinding: canonical payload, report, signed binding, signature file
rows.testCoverage: partial-apply recovery contract and CLI tests

rows.requirement: Unsigned classification is derived evidence only; every consumer can establish the signed recovery chain.
rows.consumer: plan capture, audit, approval, closure, verify-only, apply
rows.hashBinding: all raw-byte SHA domains and classification binding
rows.signatureBinding: KMS signature independently reverified at consumption
rows.testCoverage: forged classification, wrong signature, stale binding tests
rows.ciCoverage: Stage B control-plane and recovery suites

rows.requirement: Terraform show JSON is captured file-backed with bounded diagnostics, atomic cleanup, and canonical byte hashing.
rows.testCoverage: large JSON, malformed, exit, signal, collision, permissions tests

rows.requirement: Baseline authorization is address/action/field driven; aggregate counts are diagnostics only.
rows.consumer: capture, audit, approval, permission, closure, verify-only, apply
rows.hashBinding: plan JSON, canonical plan, saved plan
rows.testCoverage: plan, approval, closure, permission tests

rows.requirement: ECS task-definition replacements are accepted only as exact twelve-address container-definition rotations.
rows.consumer: plan capture, audit, permission, closure, apply
outputs: ECS_TASK_DEFINITION_ROTATION profile and exact rollover metadata
rows.testCoverage: twelve-rotation profile and negative field/action tests

rows.requirement: Recovery is orthogonal to normal plan safety and cannot authorize ECS rotation or arbitrary deletion.
outputs: normal profile plus exact alias exception
rows.expectedResourceActions: alias update plus independently valid normal actions
rows.testCoverage: recovery extra-ECS negative test and plan recovery tests

rows.requirement: Reference audit is generated from the exact plan JSON and validates current/retained ECS/Lambda references.
rows.hashBinding: plan JSON SHA and reference audit SHA
rows.testCoverage: reference audit generator and broker/task reference tests

rows.requirement: Every non-noop production-plan action, changed path, after_unknown path, replace_path, and trust-relevant Terraform configuration reference is explicitly classified by the Stage B semantic contract.
rows.consumer: plan capture, approval, permission, closure, validator, verify-only, and apply precheck
rows.identity: exact non-noop root-managed resource, address, action, path, and reference
rows.freshness: same authoritative plan and protected source bindings
rows.hashBinding: plan JSON, canonical plan, and saved-plan downstream bindings
rows.signatureBinding: downstream approval, permission, and recovery signatures
rows.expectedResourceActions: BASELINE_INITIAL_CREATE: exact twelve ECS creates plus exact broker policy/function/alias creates; ROLLOVER_RECOVERY: exact twelve ECS rollovers plus exact broker policy/function/alias updates; NO_CHANGE_OR_APPEND_ONLY_RETRY: current task-definition create/no-op mix with broker no-op
rows.failClosedBehavior: PLAN_UNEXPECTED with the exact unclassified path
rows.testCoverage: baseline production-shaped initial-create census including the full broker profile, recovery-shaped rollover census, no-op/append-only retry census, and one-semantic-element mutation matrix

rows.requirement: Permission manifest allows ECS RegisterTaskDefinition for exact rotations while retaining the explicit no-Deregister boundary.
rows.testCoverage: permission manifest and preflight tests

rows.requirement: PLAN_APPROVED binds the exact captured plan, audit, classification, source, state, and recovery chain.
rows.identity: approved operator/release chain; no plan generation in approval-only
rows.hashBinding: all plan hash domains and audit/capture SHA
rows.testCoverage: approval and plan recovery tests

rows.requirement: Closure requires the complete approved evidence graph and does not treat classification as a trust root.
rows.testCoverage: deployment closure and apply tests
rows.ciCoverage: Stage B control-plane and required closure command

rows.requirement: Canonical apply consumes only the exact approved saved plan and enables reviewed drift only from trustedRecovery.
outputs: single apply result and failure artifact where supported
rows.freshness: fresh final precheck; exact plan/state/source binding
rows.hashBinding: saved plan, plan JSON, approval, permission, closure, recovery
rows.signatureBinding: recovery KMS and administrator permission/approval chain
rows.testCoverage: apply wrapper, recovery, closure, verify-only tests

rows.requirement: Post-apply proves state, Lambda, ECS, IAM, RLS, runtime, and evidence convergence.
rows.identity: release-deployer and required read-only verification identities
rows.testCoverage: offline validators; live success is not claimed here
rows.gap: No production apply is authorized in this readiness exercise.
rows.remediation: Execute the documented post-apply read-only verification after a separately authorized deployment.

rows.requirement: Every readiness regression is reachable from required Stage B PR CI.
rows.identity: GitHub Actions runner/OIDC only where workflow requires it
rows.testCoverage: control-plane aggregator includes readiness and ECS rotation tests

rows.requirement: The historical failed plan’s exact per-resource JSON is preserved for independent forensic explanation.
rows.sourceOfTruth: failed-plan SHA supplied by operator; no local plan JSON in readiness checkout
rows.failClosedBehavior: do not authorize; require fresh plan
rows.testCoverage: negative stale-plan/recovery tests
rows.gap: Exact forensic resource table cannot be independently recomputed from this checkout.
rows.remediation: Preserve future failed-plan JSON and structured failure evidence at creation time.
